label: Dialog
description: Opens configured dialogs through XShell navigation, including confirmation, message, prompt, picker, language picker, and arbitrary page dialogs.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Single destructured options object. Fields correspond to the JavaScript method signature.

variant.description: Determines which confirmation buttons are displayed.

returns.description: Promise resolving to the value returned by navigation.navigate(); exact result shape is not specified by Dialog.
